events.content: Identify plants with the Plant.id cloud API
The backend runs on Firebase Cloud Functions
Store user plant photos in Firebase Storage
Photos are deleted after 30 days unless the user saves them
Watering reminders are local notifications scheduled on the phone
Identify plants on-device with a TensorFlow Lite model we trained
events.rationale: Plant.id cost per request and offline use in gardens

events.content: Move the backend from Firebase Cloud Functions to a FastAPI service on Cloud Run
Watering reminders are push notifications from the server, adjusted for local weather
Store plant photos in Google Cloud Storage with a 30-day lifecycle rule
